description: This file contains shell functions related to diff comparison and normalization, including functions to sanitize diff outputs and compare files while ignoring certain variability such as heuristics scores and hashes.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing specific patterns to ignore heuristics and non-essential differences.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Similar to compare_diff_raw but applies additional transformations for binary diff content and then compares.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Sanitizes and compares patch files, ignoring lines related to similarity index and diff index lines.
